title: 'Star Trek', 'X-Men' star Patrick Stewart dead at 86
summary: Patrick Stewart, the British Shakespearean actor who became a Hollywood megastar through roles in the "Star Trek" and "X-Men" franchises, has died at his home in Los Angeles. He was 86.
